source.name: FreePD
source.note: FreePD.com (Kevin MacLeod) published these tracks under CC0: free for commercial use, no attribution required, and its FAQ allows including them in an app that generates movies for users. FreePD has closed; the files come from a public mirror and are checked against the SHA-256 recorded here. Descriptions are FreePD's own.
